info.title: Axis Display Content FE API
info.description: Axis Display Content Frontend API v0.1

get.summary: Get the global configuration for an application. Should be called during app statup.
get.description: This includes things like device and playback rules, classifications, sitemap and subscriptions. You have the option to select specific configuration objects using the 'include' parameter, or if unspecified, getting all configuration.

get.summary: Returns a page with the specified path.
get.description: If targeting the search page you must url encode the search term as a parameter using the q key. For example if your browser path looks like /search?q=the then what you pass to this endpoint would look like /page?path=/search%3Fq%3Dthe.

parameters.name: item_detail_include_fields
parameters.description:
A comma delimited list of fields to be included in the response.

    This is only applicable for fields that are not included by default.
